composition.serve_who: Sheet GMMS 108'-114a "BILGE SYSTEM" is a relay/terminal wiring diagram serving THREE distinct bilge-related equipment nodes that share the +24V DC service battery supply but are separate systems per the sheet's own titled sections: (1) 520-main-bilge-pump — the MAIN BILGE PUMP motor at top-right with its Local Pump SW / T/S S control loop and Main Panel/ONYX remote paths; (2) 520-bilge-valves — the five BURKERT-type motorised bilge valves (labelled "BILGE VALVE ENG. ROOM BILGE" x5, each with OPEN/CLOSE contacts) fed via Q13 10A BILGE VALVES breaker through relays Re1-Re5 and T/S B/T/S C; (3) 520-vega-bilge-level-sensors — the six "BILGE SW" level-switch endpoints (Port/Stbd Lazarette, Aft, Eng Room, Fwd, Sail Locker) that report status via XA40/XA10/XA11 taps and ultimately light the open/closed lamp bank on the MAIN PANEL PC CARD. The Main Panel / Plug C / Plug D / PC Card block is the operator interface for all three, cross-referencing 641-vessel-control-panel. Evidence: title block "BILGE SYSTEM"; load labels BILGE VALVES Q13, MAIN BILGE PUMP, BILGE SW sensor names, and the switch names S20-S24 explicitly naming each bilge zone valve/lamp pairing on the Main Panel.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Motor explicitly labelled MAIN BILGE PUMP top-right of sheet; fed via F3 60A / SW8 / SO6 into T/S S control terminals 13/14/15, matching the register mapping BILGE PUMP -> 520-main-bilge-pump and the established engineer red-pen control_loop fact for this exact sheet (GM-114a).

functions.label: Main bilge pump run/stop control loop
functions.what_it_does: Runs the main bilge pump motor to discharge bilge water; the solenoid contactor coil (T/S S terminals 13/14) can be closed from any of three alternative locations, consistent with the established multi-switch activation fact for this pump on this sheet.

flow_scenarios.path: +24V service battery -> F2 200A -> F3 60A -> SW8 -> SO6 solenoid -> T/S S terminals 13/14/15 -> pump motor contactor coil de-energised, pump idle

LOCAL PUMP SW (adjacent to T/S S, terminal 1/2 stub) closes -> T/S S terminal 15 -> contactor coil energised -> MAIN BILGE PUMP motor runs, discharge overboard (per established emergency-suction fact, via STBD generator raw-water pump path when in that mode)
MAIN PANEL BILGE PUMP SW (S13, lamp symbol) at Plug C -> plug/cable run -> T/S S control lines -> contactor coil energised -> pump runs; lamp on S13 indicates pump engaged

ONYX command over XA11 tap <32> -> terminal 50 on T/S C -> relay Re6 contact closes -> T/S S control line -> contactor coil energised -> pump runs (cross-reference: ONYX wiring detailed on monitoring sheet)

functions.label: Motorised bilge valve open/close control (5 valves, one per bilge zone line)
functions.what_it_does: Each of the five bilge valve actuators opens or closes its bilge suction line on command, selecting which bilge compartment is connected to the pump manifold; each valve is driven by its own relay off the shared Q13 supply.

flow_scenarios.path: +24V service battery -> BILGE VALVES Q13 10A breaker -> T/S B terminals 8-13 -> relay coils Re1-Re5 de-energised, valve actuators idle/last-position
T/S C OPEN contact (terminals 7,16,24,32,40 per valve) closes -> relay Re(n) energises -> valve actuator motor M terminal [2] -> valve opens, connecting that bilge zone's suction line to the main run
T/S C CLOSE contact (terminals 8,17,25,33,41 per valve) closes -> relay Re(n) energises -> valve actuator motor M terminal [3] -> valve closes, isolating that bilge zone's suction line

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Six 'BILGE SW' endpoints (Port Lazarette, Stbd Lazarette, Aft, Eng Room, Fwd, Sail Locker) are level-switch sensors reporting bilge state; their signals feed the XA40/XA10/XA11 taps and ultimately the Main Panel PC Card open/closed lamp bank — this is the bilge level sensing/monitoring function, matching register category 520-vega-bilge-level-sensors (Bilge and fire system).

functions.label: Bilge level switch status reporting (6 zones)
functions.what_it_does: Each zone's bilge switch detects presence of water and reports status (open/closed level state) back through the wiring loom to the monitoring taps and to the Main Panel PC Card indicator lamps for that zone, letting an operator see which bilge is engaged.

flow_scenarios.path: BILGE SW contact open (no water) -> no signal on status line -> Main Panel PC Card lamp for that zone shows 'closed' (valve/level default) via diode-isolated +24V lamp array

BILGE SW contact closes at rising water -> status line runs via drawn line to valve motor circuit tap (junction near valve output) -> onward via XA40 (Lazarette/Aft zones) or XA10 (Eng Room/Fwd/Sail Locker zones) monitoring taps -> external monitoring loom (cross-reference, sheet not given) -> also correlates with Main Panel PC Card lamp 'open' for that zone

infrastructure.system_name: 24V Service Battery Distribution (feed/fuse/switch row, terminal strips T/S S / T/S B / T/S C, relay bank Re1-Re6, Plug C/Plug D interconnect)
facts: +24V SERVICE BAT. feeds this sheet via F2 200A main fuse, then splits to F3 60A (pump/solenoid branch) and Q13 10A BILGE VALVES branch
T/S S, T/S B, T/S C are terminal strips distributing control signals; T/S C carries the large numbered field (1-50) routing open/close/valve/bilge-sw wiring
Relay bank Re1-Re6 sits on this distribution backbone, not owned by any single valve/pump — Re1-Re5 drive individual bilge valves, Re6 relates to ONYX/pump remote path
Main Panel interconnect Plug C (12-pin) and Plug D (12-pin) carry switch/lamp signals between this sheet's terminal strips and the Main Panel PC Card enclosure

infrastructure.system_name: Main Panel / Vessel Control Panel bilge controls (Plug C switches S20-S24/S13, AUX plug, Pedestal Alarm Mod + Mute, PC Card lamp bank)
facts: MAIN PANEL section on this sheet hosts switches S20 (Lazarette Bilge), S21 (Aft Bilge), S22 (Eng Room Bilge), S23 (Fwd Bilge), S24 (Sail Locker), and S13 (Bilge Pump SW with lamp)
AUX PLUG ON PC BOARD mates pins [8]-[12] to [1]-[4] of Plug C
PEDESTAL ALARM MOD + MUTE provides an audible alarm with mute switch, wired into Plug C terminals 8-12
PLUG D (12 pins) carries signals onward into the dotted-outline MAIN PANEL PC CARD enclosure, which hosts open/closed indicator lamps for each bilge zone plus a +24V diode-isolated supply rail
